## Before submitting

- [x] I agree to license this contribution under the terms of [LICENSE.txt](https://github.com/NVIDIA/cudnn-frontend/blob/develop/LICENSE.txt).
- [x] I ran `pre-commit run` and committed any formatting changes.
- [x] I reviewed the Hard Rules in the `AGENTS.md` for each directory this PR touches (see [root AGENTS.md § Reviewing a PR](https://github.com/NVIDIA/cudnn-frontend/blob/develop/AGENTS.md#reviewing-a-pr-human-or-agent)) and my changes comply, or I explain the exception below.
- [ ] I added GitHub labels: one `cat-*`, one or more `area:*` / `op:*`, and one `orig-*` (see [label list](https://github.com/NVIDIA/cudnn-frontend/labels)). I cannot set labels on this repository; suggested: `orig-external`, `cat-bugfix`, `area:test`.

## Affected area

Tests

## Summary

JAX is an optional dependency group (pyproject `jax`). Without it, collecting `gemm/` or the whole suite fails:

```
ERROR gemm/jax/test_gemm_amax_jax.py - ModuleNotFoundError: No module named 'jax.numpy'
... (one per gemm/jax module)
!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!! Interrupted: 17 errors during collection !!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!
```

The cause is the test directory itself. `test/python/gemm/jax` has no `__init__.py`. pytest's prepend import mode puts `test/python/gemm` on `sys.path` as soon as it collects a `gemm/test_*.py` file. From then on `import jax` resolves to that directory as a namespace package, so `pytest.importorskip("jax")` passes and the module fails at `import jax.numpy`. Collecting `gemm/jax` on its own skips correctly, because nothing has put `gemm/` on the path yet.

The root `conftest.py` now records JAX as absent (`sys.modules["jax"] = None`) when `importlib.util.find_spec("jax")` finds nothing, or only a namespace directory. It does this at conftest import, before any test path is added. As a result, every `importorskip("jax")` skips: both at module level in `gemm/jax` and inside the two `gemm/cutedsl/test_grouped_gemm_dglu_workspace.py` tests. The XLA target gate's `import jax` also sees no JAX. An installed JAX is a regular package with an origin and is left alone.

## Why

Without the fix, an environment set up with the torch group only cannot run `pytest -m L0` over the tree: the session stops at collection.

## Related issues

None found.

## API and compatibility impact

None. Test harness only.

## Testing

GH200 (aarch64), develop `4cd4e613` plus this branch's `conftest.py` (unchanged between `4cd4e613` and `fb1d3bf8`, the base of this branch), no JAX installed, run from `test/python`:

| Command | develop | this PR |
|---|---|---|
| `python -m pytest --collect-only -q -m "L0 or L1 or L2"` | 76962 collected, **17 errors** (`No module named 'jax.numpy'`), session interrupted | 76962 collected, no errors |
| `python -m pytest -p no:xdist --noconftest --collect-only -q gemm/test_swiglu_mlp.py gemm/jax gemm/cutedsl/test_grouped_gemm_dglu_workspace.py`, with the new block loaded as a plugin for this PR | 17 errors (`No module named 'jax.numpy'`) | no errors |
| `python -m pytest -rs gemm/test_swiglu_mlp.py gemm/jax gemm/cutedsl/test_grouped_gemm_dglu_workspace.py -k jax` (the first file is collected only to put `gemm/` on the path) | | 17 skipped, one per `gemm/jax` module (`could not import 'jax'`) |

The second row isolates the mechanism with no CUDA device: only `gemm/test_swiglu_mlp.py` is needed to put `gemm/` on the path. Not run: an environment with JAX installed. There `find_spec("jax")` returns the installed package with an origin, and the new block does nothing.

* **Chores**
  * Improved test setup behavior when JAX is unavailable, helping test runs handle environments without the optional package consistently. No changes to user-facing functionality.

detail.title: test: skip the JAX tests cleanly when JAX is not installed

files.patch:
@@ -24,6 +24,7 @@
 
 import faulthandler
 import gc
+import importlib.util
 import re
 import socket
 import subprocess
@@ -361,6 +362,20 @@ def _apply_tier_markers(config, items):
             item.add_marker(pytest.mark.nightly_only)
 
 
+# =================== JAX absent =====================
+# JAX is optional (pyproject's ``jax`` group). Without it, the test directory
+# gemm/jax -- which has no __init__.py -- imports as a namespace package named
+# ``jax`` as soon as pytest's prepend import mode puts test/python/gemm on
+# sys.path, which it does for gemm/test_*.py. pytest.importorskip("jax") then
+# passes and each gemm/jax module dies at ``import jax.numpy``: a collection
+# error per module, which interrupts the whole session. Record the absence
+# before any test path is added, so every importorskip("jax") skips and the
+# gate below sees no JAX.
+_jax_spec = importlib.util.find_spec("jax")
+if _jax_spec is None or _jax_spec.origin is None:  # not installed, or only a namespace directory
+    sys.modules["jax"] = None
+
+
 # =================== JAX/XLA target gate =====================
 # XLA cannot compile for every GPU these tests run on, and when it cannot it
 # does not raise -- it prints
